$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-twilio-sms-source). Seeds the pre-built `twilio-sms` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's TwilioSmsClient. The Twilio Messaging API authenticates with HTTP Basic (username=AccountSID, password=AuthToken) and the AccountSID also appears in the request path (`/2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSID}/Messages.json`). Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with the Twilio API base URL and auth:apikey so a fresh install resolves the endpoint without carrying a secret. To enable: (1) set `configuration.authentication.username` to your AccountSID and `configuration.authentication.password` to your AuthToken (HTTP Basic); (2) the consuming app composes the `Accounts/{AccountSID}/Messages.json` send path so the AccountSID is supplied by the operator, not by end-user input; (3) flip isEnabled via the OpenConnector Sources UI. Twilio expects an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The base URL is admin-owned on the source (no SSRF surface). OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST) — provider selection / STOP opt-out / dedupe / delivery-status reconciliation stay in the consuming app (pipelinq SmsAdapter).

objects.description: Twilio Messaging API (SMS). Consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (POST a single SMS). Dormant placeholder — the base URL is the production Twilio API endpoint; set `configuration.authentication.username` (AccountSID) + `configuration.authentication.password` (AuthToken) for HTTP Basic and enable. Send path is `2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSID}/Messages.json` (form-encoded body From/To/Body).
